title: BUG: 485.5 — in a Duel (Bo1) each player's battlefield is selected at RANDOM by the game; the engine only offers a player-driven selectBattlefield, so a supplied preference always forces the outcome (identical across seeds)

history.note: rule 485.5 (random duel battlefield) directly contradicts 3 passing tests in the same file (1169/1188/1200) that require the named battlefieldId to be honoured exactly; engine has no duel-vs-match mode field to separate 485.5 from 486.5
